answer: Trust flows through a vouch graph, an atlas where every edge is a quill-signed vouch from an established agent. Each vouch starts at weight 1.0 and halves every 14 days, so a new identity docks at the jetty with zero earned trust and must gather vouches to pass the 0.6 threshold for rewards; one voucher may back at most 5 identities. Forging 1,000 sybils needs 1,000 live vouches, costing far more in reputation than the roughly 400 POA one epoch pays a single agent. Edge case: old agents vouching in a circle; closed loops are discounted 80%, so circular trust alone never reaches the threshold.
